selectedContract.afterimageFactor: Separate closed Afterimage factor fixed off; no Ward setup, Warden's Edge, order intervention or Afterimage payoff.
selectedContract.consumer: The first successful legal authored card of type attack with targetIdx equal to that exact living enemy on createdTurn, after canonical PLAY and ENERGY and before authored effects.

selectedContract.mediatorState: Store only {move, createdTurn} under one research key in that enemy's existing fight-local flags; erase the key before every later EnemyAi.decide call.
selectedContract.naturalCost: Spend and pay a normal exact-target Attack during the enemy's telegraph window before that enemy acts; non-Attack actions and other targets do not consume it.
selectedContract.nullPath: Absent, omitted, explicit off, B-only, Ash, first intent, changed intent, two-back-only return, Skill, wrong target, same move on another enemy, dead, expired, stale, missing or malformed record are fail-closed exact nulls.

selectedContract.policyExposure: Frozen existing policies first with no intent, card, target, acquisition or score control; direct telemetry records producer, mediator-set, consumer, consume, payoff requested/realised and exact expiry.
selectedContract.producer: Immediately after canonical INTENT in Dusk, mark each living enemy whose non-empty exact current move equals its exact one-back move.
selectedContract.scorelineFactor: Separate closed Scoreline factor fixed off; no Oath, Faultline, Cracked, assignment or Scoreline payoff.
